slides.headline: Free shuttle now links East End and North Side
slides.label: The Eastern Link is a free four-month public transport pilot that started 1 October. It runs Monday to Saturday, 7:30 am to 7:30 pm, not on public holidays. If you transfer to an existing public bus, the normal bus fare applies.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): The Eastern Link Connecting East End and North Side to Launch 1 October
slides.qualification: The release names three services and Frank Sound Junction as the connection to existing buses; stop lists were attachments not shown on the page. No end date is given beyond four months. The four-month duration is stated, but an exact end date is not supplied.

slides.headline: Electricity fuel-charge cap and fuel duty waiver now run to 31 December
slides.label: Government extended the 2026 Fuel Relief Programme by three months. The residential electricity fuel charge stays capped at CI$0.18 per kWh, and the 100% import-duty waiver on gasoline, diesel and propane continues.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): Government extends fuel relief programme through December 2026
slides.qualification: The waiver removes the Government duty; it does not set or freeze pump prices. The release's example saving is about $70.44 a month on 1,200 kWh at September's fuel rate.

slides.headline: No-cost mammogram in October for CG BritCay Premier and Provident members
slides.label: The insurer says members of those two plans can get a mammogram at Doctors Hospital with nothing to pay out of pocket during October, without using their annual wellness allowance. Appointments are limited. The booking number is in the insurer's notice; say which plan you are on when you call.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): CG BritCay reintroduces complimentary mammogram initiative
slides.qualification: A company's offer to its own policyholders, carried by Radio Cayman. Listed because it is a benefit members may not know they have; it is not an advertisement or an endorsement.

slides.headline: Local TVET grant guidance
slides.label: The Ministry FAQ says applications may be submitted year-round and decisions are issued quarterly.
slides.qualification: Evergreen guidance, not a dated opening or award guarantee. Confirm current programme rules in the portal.

slides.headline: Check financial assistance requirements
slides.label: Government guidance describes nationality or family-link, residence and household financial tests. Review the requirements before applying.
slides.qualification: Reference updated 10 October 2024; not a finding that you qualify. Household thresholds and the final assessment must be checked with DFA.

slides.headline: Small Business Expo on 21 October
slides.label: CICBD lists the Expo at Hotel Indigo Grand Cayman and links attendee registration.
slides.qualification: The date is confirmed; start/end times and admission price are not stated in the captured text. Exhibitor applications closed 13 September. Confirm attendance details. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

slides.headline: Importing a car? Model year eight years or older is prohibited
slides.label: Customs and Border Control reminded the public on 14 September that vehicles whose model year is eight years or older cannot be imported, subject to listed exemptions. It asks buyers to check before purchasing as the end of the year approaches.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): CBC Reminds Public of Vehicle Import Restrictions
slides.qualification: Exemptions are in Section 4A(2) of the Prohibited Goods Order; the release does not list them. Ask CBC before you buy.

slides.headline: Scholarship dates disagree across official pages
slides.label: The dated April update announces a November–September cycle from 1 November 2026. The Ministry FAQ still shows the earlier overseas and local windows.
slides.qualification: Revision comparison only. The public portal landing does not settle a programme-specific deadline; confirm directly before preparing an application. The latest source check was unavailable; this is retained last-good information. Recheck the official source before acting.

slides.headline: Gazette timetable and generic instructions differ
slides.label: The 2026 table and the general submission paragraph on the same official page give different deadline rules.
slides.qualification: The dated 2026 table lists 16 October at noon for both sectors; the same page’s generic instructions use different weekday rules. Confirm with the Gazette Office before relying on this deadline.

slides.headline: Cayman Airways' last nonstop New York flight is 19 October
slides.label: The airline is ending its Grand Cayman to New York JFK nonstop service. The final flight operates on 19 October 2026.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): Cayman Airways to conclude its New York service
slides.qualification: If you hold a booking after 19 October, check it with Cayman Airways. The release does not describe rebooking or refunds.

slides.headline: Police: never share your six-digit WhatsApp code
slides.label: RCIPS says scammers are taking over local WhatsApp accounts by asking for the six-digit verification code, then messaging the owner's contacts for money. Turn on two-step verification, and call the person before sending money.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): Police Warn of Ongoing WhatsApp Impersonation Scams
slides.qualification: The advice to call the person first is ordinary caution, not a quote from the release.

slides.headline: Driving licence fees changed on 1 September: discounts for longer licences, reduced fee at 65
slides.label: Caymanians buying three-, five- and ten-year licences get 10%, 15% and 20% off. Customers aged 65 or older qualify for the reduced fee, including non-Caymanian seniors. Non-Caymanian full licence fees are about three times the Caymanian rate, down from the eight times first approved.
slides.source_label: Radio Cayman (Government): Revised DVDL Fee Structure Effective 1 September 2026
slides.qualification: If you think the wrong fee was applied, go to a DVDL office with your receipt and ID. The release gives ratios and discounts, not a full price list.
